```python
import narwhals as nw

# Example DataFrame with spend column
df = nw.from_dict({"spend": [500, 1000, 1500, 800, 2000]})

# Add tier column using conditional expression
df = df.with_columns(
    tier=nw.when(nw.col("spend") >= 1000)
        .then(nw.lit("gold"))
        .otherwise(nw.lit("standard"))
)

print(df)
```
